_comment: Drift sites (workspace rule 7 self-contained-script convention). Each site names a SIBLING SET whose duplicated boilerplate SHOULD match after normalized-text diff (ODP-2: strip comments + whitespace). drift_check.py compares each set; divergence is an advisory WARNING (rule 4 — never blocker, never changes exit code). variation_allowed marks a set whose siblings are EXPECTED to differ (skipped). This registry is the heuristic surface; drift_check.py is the deterministic comparator over it. v1 scope: emit-across-adapters (the canonical rule-7 duplication). Register more sites (have / run / find_marker_dirs across arch_contract_*.py) as their sibling sets stabilize — add a site here, never edit the checker.

sites.name: emit-across-adapters
sites.note: the emit(findings, coverage) helper is the canonical rule-7 duplication across the adapter family; a divergent emit is a drift signal
